getPaid.q: How I go take collect pay for shift?
getPaid.a: After we match you to job, apply make you get 4-digit confirmation code. For site, the employer go confirm your attendance — that one go release the escrow pay straight into your Provira wallet, wey you fit withdraw go your bank.

proviraScore.a: Na reliability score wey we build from your real activity — shifts wey you complete, on-time rate, sales wey you log, and loans wey you pay back. Higher score go unlock better jobs and bigger loans. We explain every point for the My standing page.

logSale.q: Why I suppose log every sale?
logSale.a: Every sale wey you log go become part of track record wey person fit verify. Na that record dey qualify you for stock loan — the more consistent your sales, the bigger the working capital wey you fit access.

escrowProtect.q: How escrow dey protect my money?
escrowProtect.a: When you fund job, we go hold the pay for dedicated escrow account — we never send am give worker yet. Na only when worker confirm attendance with dem code we go release am, so you no dey pay for no-show.

hireWorkers.q: How I go take hire reliable workers?
hireWorkers.a: Post job, fund im escrow, then tap Find workers. We dey match workers by skill and reliability score, so you go first see people wey get proven track record.

loans.a: Loan eligibility base on your Provira Score. Approved loans go disburse go your payout account, and if you pay back on time e go raise your score — and unlock bigger limit next time.

verify.q: How I go take verify my identity?
verify.a: Go Verify identity, enter your 11-digit NIN, and add payout bank account. We go confirm the account name before we save am, and we dey store sensitive numbers encrypt — we no dey keep the raw values.

dataSafe.a: Yes. Sensitive identifiers like your NIN, we dey hash am, we dey confirm payout details before we use am, and we dey always deliver security and payment alert so you no dey blind about your money.

Security.title: Your money and your data, we don protect am
Security.lede: Trust na the product. Here na exactly how we dey keep funds safe, identities private, and both sides of every job accountable.

escrow.title: Escrow-protected funds
escrow.body: We dey hold employer funds with CBN-licensed partner bank and release am only when dem confirm attendance. No confirmation, no release.

encryption.title: Encryption everywhere
encryption.body: We dey protect traffic with TLS for transit, and sensitive identifiers like your NIN, we dey encrypt am at rest — we no dey store am plain.

access.title: Least-privilege access
access.body: Access to production data na role-based, we dey log am, and e dey limited to wetin each task strictly need. No standing access to your records.

rails.title: Licensed payment rails
rails.body: Payouts dey run through licensed payment providers over regulated infrastructure — the same rails wey Nigerian banks dey trust.

fraud.title: Fraud & anomaly checks
fraud.body: Attendance codes, verified identities, and behavioural checks dey reduce no-shows, impersonation, and payout abuse for both sides.

ndpr.title: NDPR-aligned by design
ndpr.body: We dey collect the minimum wey we need, tell you why, and honour your data rights under Nigeria Data Protection Regulation.

Security.disclosureSubtitle: We welcome report from security researchers and we dey treat dem with priority.
Security.disclosureBody: Abeg email <email>security@provira.com.ng</email> with details and steps to reproduce. Give us reasonable window make we fix the issue before public disclosure — and abeg no access or modify data wey no be your own.
Security.ctaBody: Every payout, identity, and record, we dey handle am with the care wey e deserve.

About.heroTitle: Turning everyday work into economic identity
About.heroLede: Millions of Nigerians dey work hard every single day, but a lifetime of effort no dey leave any paper trail wey bank fit trust. Provira dey change that — one job, one sale, one confirmed shift at a time.
About.whyTitle: The economy dey run on work wey stay invisible
About.storyP1: The market trader wey dey restock for early morning, the crew wey dey load warehouse for night, the cleaner wey no dey miss shift — na dem dey keep the country moving. But when dem need capital, fair wage on time, or just proof of wetin dem don do, the system no get anything to show.
About.storyP2: Provira dey give that work memory. Every completed job, logged sale, and on-time repayment dey become part of verifiable record — the <s>Provira Score</s> — wey employers, banks, and lenders fit actually check. Work dey become reputation. Reputation dey become credit.

Faq.heroTitle: Everything wey you need to know
Faq.heroLede: You still dey curious after you don read? The Help Center dey go deeper, or you fit reach person any time.
Faq.cantFind: You no fit find your answer? <help>Browse the Help Center</help> or <contact>contact us</contact>.

speed.q: How fast workers dey actually collect pay?
speed.a: Same day. The moment dem confirm attendance with employer 4-digit code, dem go release the escrow pay to worker Provira wallet and e fit withdraw am go im bank — no waiting days for invoice.

smartphone.q: I need smartphone to use Provira?
smartphone.a: No. Provira na phone-first: you fit sign up, confirm shifts, and check your balance for USSD (*347*82#) or WhatsApp. Smartphone dey unlock the full app, but e no dey compulsory.

score.q: How the Provira Score dey work?
score.a: Every completed job, on-time arrival, logged sale, and repaid loan dey add to your score. No-shows and disputes dey subtract. Na honest, verifiable record wey banks and lenders fit check — na im dey turn your work into real credit.

protection.q: How dem dey protect my money?
protection.a: Dem dey hold employer funds for escrow with CBN-licensed partner bank and dem go only release am on confirmed attendance. Payouts dey run through licensed payment provider, and sensitive identifiers like your NIN dey store encrypt, never plain.

cost.a: Sign up, collect pay, and build your score na free for workers and traders. Employers dey pay small, transparent fee per completed hire — with no monthly minimums.

availability.a: We dey roll out state by state, starting for Lagos. Workers and employers anywhere for Nigeria fit sign up now and set dem location down to the ward, so we go match you the moment jobs go live near you.

languages.q: I fit use Provira for Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo or Pidgin?
languages.a: Yes. Provira interface, buttons, emails and notifications dey built to work for English, Nigerian Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo. Choose your language from the menu — we dey save am and e dey follow you across devices.

changeLang.q: I fit change my language any time?
changeLang.a: Any time — from the language menu for the navigation or from your settings. We dey remember your choice and use am automatically next time you visit or sign in.

notifications.q: Dem go translate emails and notifications too?
notifications.a: Yes. System messages — one-time codes, job offers, attendance prompts and payout alerts — dey localized to your chosen language across the app, SMS, USSD and WhatsApp.

ugc.q: Employers fit post jobs and traders fit sell for local languages?
ugc.a: You fit write posts and listings for your own language today. One-tap translation of user-generated content — job posts, product descriptions, receipts and chats — dey our roadmap, so worker wey prefer Hausa fit read post wey dem write for English, and vice versa.
